premises.text: Social TV and similar apps face a hard real-time big-data problem: process huge concurrent streams and push results back to audiences very quickly
premises.evidence_span: That's a real-time big data problem, where you have to take that deluge of data, you have to process it, and then you have to transmit it back out to the audience very, very quickly

premises.text: Bright Context is a cloud platform for developers that processes in-flight real-time data streams and adds real-time push/broadcast into apps via an easy API
premises.evidence_span: we provide a cloud-based platform for software developers that makes it easy to do two key things. To take large streams of data that are in flight, real-time, and to process them. And then two, to incorporate real-time data push and broadcast into your apps through an API

premises.text: Developers configure through/quant channels in a dashboard, link via SDK, and offload scaling and back-end complexity
premises.evidence_span: you've offloaded a huge amount of complexity to us in terms of scaling and back-end, and you've freed yourself up to create amazing front-end experiences

premises.text: Adoption is via self-service developers plus a cloud-based pricing model that lowers the barrier to sophisticated real-time backends
premises.evidence_span: we're engaging developers directly through a self-service model

value.text: Empower developers to build real-time apps without owning hard stream-processing infrastructure
value.evidence_span: we're here to empower you to disrupt and innovate around real-time

causal_links.evidence_span: This problem right here, this is a hard problem. This is the problem that Bright Context Platform solves
we gift wrap it for developers
our platform will be adopted more broadly, more quickly, and more creatively through partnering with innovative developers
